notes.title: Two new Team17 games to be announced next week!
notes.content:

With E3 approaching and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/686810/Hell_Let_Loose/]Hell Let Loose[/url] releasing on the 6th of June, it’s fair to say that Team17 has a very busy week ahead! In fact, next week we’ll be unveiling not just one but TWO BRAND NEW GAME ANNOUNCEMENTS!

You’re not going to want to miss these announcements, and we really can’t wait to share the trailers with you. To ensure that you’re the first to hear about these new games right here on Steam, make sure to follow the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Team17]Team17 Publisher Page[/url].

In the meantime, you can find a couple of cryptic clues in the image above, and if you hop over to the [url=https://twitter.com/Team17Ltd/status/1134368934923296770]Team17 Twitter account[/url], make your predictions, follow and re-tweet then you’ll be entered into a prize draw to win a copy of these two games, and Hell Let Loose, upon release!

Thanks for reading, and we’ll see you next week!

notes.title: Team17 - 100th Game Celebration
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32941731/ce201387f7d4e82ee6ad0624c277acea9e6a229a.png[/img]

With the release of PLANET ALPHA on 4th September 2018, Team17 will have released 100 games! This landmark includes games developed and/or published here at Team17, ranging from our early Amiga days with the likes of Alien Breed, Body Blows and Project X, through the explosion in popularity of the Worms series, our work-for-hire period on franchises like Lemmings and Leisure Suit Larry right through to the modern age and our indie games label featuring The Escapists, Overcooked and Yooka-Laylee!

https://youtu.be/CfGBMGPl_5s

Our celebration begins today with the retrospective video above, as well as a new trailer for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/485030/PLANET_ALPHA/]PLANET ALPHA[/url], available to pre-order now with a 10% discount!

There's more to come too! Keep an eye on Team17's [url=https://www.facebook.com/Team17/]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/Team17Ltd]Twitter[/url] channels for more activities throughout the year, including behind-the-scenes retropspectives, competitions and fun with friends!

What's your favourite Team17 game of all time? Why not join us in the official [url=discord.gg/team17]Team17 Discord[/url] server and let us know?

notes.title: Vehicular puzzler Mugsters looks a little like Blast Corps
notes.content:
Aliens have invaded – what’s your your first weapon of choice? Laser gun? Nukes? Mugsters posits that an ice-cream truck will do the job. It’s a vehicular action-puzzler by solo indie dev Reinkout and published by Team 17. I’ve been following development of this one ever since I saw some animated GIFs of it on the developer’s Twitter feed. Why? Because it looks like N64 classic Blast Corps mashed up with a little Grand Theft Auto and maybe a dash of Body Harvest (for anyone that remembers that), so is entirely my jam. It’s also out today.

(more…)

notes.title: When you fail in Mugsters, just know you're not alone!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30705873/078088e97964de0c5ea398e4b2a56ad8f40801cd.gif[/img]
Hey everyone

We've just released a brand new trailer for [b]Mugsters[/b], this time focusing on fails. Even the best laid out plans are bound to end in disaster, and this latest trailer is dedicated to the many ways things can go horribly, horribly wrong!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IocuOMoL0oM
While a fail (and untimely demise) in single-player does mean a quick restart of the island, failing in local co-op is less "severe", as you can simply revive your co-op partner, so you can get back to perfecting that plan in seconds.

Do let us know how you plan to [strike]fail[/strike] play Mugsters (single-player, co-op, or both!) when [b]Mugsters launches on Steam, PS4, Xbox One and Nintendo Switch on July 17th[/b] - that's next week!!

notes.title: Mugsters arrives on July 17th
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32941731/fb7b3c868afc822ba6e50c07135f9da48eb4df7f.gif[/img]
Greetings, fellow humans!

The aliens have held our world long enough, and it’s now almost time to take it back. Our teleporters are ready to bring you to the heart of the alien occupation on July 17th, so you can start liberating fellow humans while blowing up those pesky invaders!

We’ve prepared a vehicle instruction video to help you on your way, so you know exactly how you can utilise your vast array of available vehicles in the best way possible. Ultimately, exactly how you go about finishing your mission – which involves exploring islands, saving humans, collecting crystals, driving and flying various vehicles, and blowing things up – is up to you!

Check out our latest trailer here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CuLuE2hkppc
Remember that you can bring along a friend if you don’t want to face the alien threat by yourself, and every island has been remixed to offer a different experience whether you play it alone, or in local co-op. [b]Will you be playing Mugsters by yourself, or with a friend?[/b]

Beyond just Steam, Mugsters will also be available on PlayStation 4, Xbox One and Nintendo Switch on July 17th 2018, and to celebrate our release date announcement, we’ll be livestreaming a couple of co-op levels on Friday. We’ll be sharing more details about the livestream right here and across our social channels later in the week.  

Be sure to join the conversation either in the comments below, over on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/712180/discussions/0/]the Community Hub[/url], on [url=https://www.facebook.com/mugstersvideogame/]Facebook[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/mugstersgame]Twitter[/url], or on [url=http://discord.gg/team17]the Team17 Discord server[/url]. We can’t wait to see the shenanigans you get up to in Mugsters!

notes.title: The Aliens Have Arrived!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30705873/d90312723944e838aaf31f17c3e44b7479e1b3e3.gif[/img]
Attention, everyone!

We’ve got some troubling news. Your world has been taken by aliens, and it’s up to you to take it back! Are you up for the task? Maybe you can get some inspiration in the brand new trailer below, showcasing some of the shenanigans you can get up to with the aliens in Mugsters.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SxX7zPwHTC4
The aliens are doing who knows what to your fellow humans, and it’s of the utmost importance that you free them before the aliens finish doing… whatever they’re doing. Should you get a chance to destroy some of the alien machines, or collect some of their mysterious crystals, we’d strongly encourage you to do that too. Oh, and remember to keep an eye on any vehicles that can get you off each island as soon as you’re done!

Let us know what you think of Mugsters so far in the comments below, and if you have any questions about the game, fire away here or on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/712180/discussions/]community hub[/url]. Be sure to follow Mugsters on [url=https://twitter.com/MugstersGame]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/mugstersvideogame/]Facebook[/url], or join the conversation over on [url=http://discord.gg/team17]Discord[/url].
